name.ja: SD 三国創傑伝 天覇曹操ウイングガンダム
name.en: SD Sangoku Soketsuden Tenha Cao Cao Wing Gundam

description.ja: • 『三国志』をベースにしたSD ガンダムが装いも新たに登場！
description.en: • SD Gundam based on "Romance of the Three Kingdoms" now has a new look!

description.ja: • 進化したプロポーションとパーツ分割へのこだわりにより、組み立てただけでSD史上最高峰の色分けを実現。
description.en: • With advanced proportions and attention to parts division, we have achieved the highest color separation in SD history using just the assembly.

description.ja: • 一新された頭身バランスと各所の関節構造により、躍動感あふれるポージングを再現！
description.en: • The all-new head and body balance and joint structure in various parts allow for dynamic poses!

description.ja: • 本体に加えて武装もパワーアップ！超大型剣"天覇双翔剣"が付属！
description.en: • In addition to the main body, the weapons are also powered up! Super large sword "Tenha Soshoken" is included!

description.ja: • ギ・エリアの夏侯惇、夏侯淵、荀イク、張遼、張郃、典韋、徐晃（別売り）との合体が可能！
description.en: • Can be combined with Gi Area's Xiahou Dun, Xiahou Yuan, Xun Iku, Zhang Liao, Zhang He, Dian Wei, and Xu Huang (sold separately)!

description.ja: • 背中のスロットにはメモリを8枚装備可能！
description.en: • You can install 8 pieces of memory in the slot on the back!
